newsitem.title: USA: Boeing, Rockwell finish consent solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Boeing, Rockwell finish consent solicitation.

text.p: Boeing Co said Monday that bondholders of Rockwell International Corp have approved a supplemental indenture for Rockwell's six series of debt securities totalling $1.6 billion.
Boeing and Rockwell conducted the consent solicitation in connection with Boeing's acqusition of Rockwell's aerospace and defense business assets.
The companies sought the consent soliciation to allow Boeing to assume substantially all of Rockwell's debt in connection with the acquisition.

Boeing said amendments to the indenture will not become effective and no consent fee will be payable until the merger between Rockwell and a subsidiary of Boeing becomes effective. Boeing said it expects the merger to occur December 6.
